\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{جدول} \fa{زمانی}}

\section[(dialogue)]{Saying no and looking back — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R139-first-pass-saying-no-and-looking-back}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an advert and a receipt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item still, a word that opens a yes-or-no question, at all, surely ... not?, when
  \item recently, already, last year, once, to spend
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Still? (\textbf{\fa{هنوز}}, \emph{hanuz}.) A word that opens a yes-or-no question? (\textbf{\fa{آیا}}, \emph{âyâ}.) At all? (\textbf{\fa{اصلا}}, \emph{aslan}.) Surely ... not?? (\textbf{\fa{مگر}}, \emph{magar}.) When? (\textbf{\fa{چه} \fa{وقت}}, \emph{che vaqt}.) Recently? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{تازگی}}, \emph{be-tâzegi}.) Already? (\textbf{\fa{قبلا}}, \emph{qablan}.) Last year? (\textbf{\fa{پارسال}}, \emph{pârsâl}.) Once? (\textbf{\fa{یک} \fa{بار}}, \emph{yek bâr}.) To spend? (\textbf{\fa{سپری} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{separi kardan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking ahead and reading signs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R139-second-pass-looking-ahead-and-reading-signs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for next and from now on.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item next, from now on, a plan, to decide, to hope
  \item a timetable, a sign, rent, an advert, a receipt
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Next? (\textbf{\fa{آینده}}, \emph{âyande}.) From now on? (\textbf{\fa{از} \fa{حالا}}, \emph{az hâlâ}.) A plan? (\textbf{\fa{طرح}}, \emph{tarh}.) To decide? (\textbf{\fa{تصمیم} \fa{گرفتن}}, \emph{tasmim gereftan}.) To hope? (\textbf{\fa{امیدوار} \fa{بودن}}, \emph{omidvâr budan}.) A timetable? (\textbf{\fa{جدول} \fa{زمانی}}, \emph{jadval-e zamâni}.) A sign? (\textbf{\fa{تابلو}}, \emph{tâblo}.) Rent? (\textbf{\fa{اجاره}}, \emph{ejâre}.) An advert? (\textbf{\fa{آگهی}}, \emph{âgahi}.) A receipt? (\textbf{\fa{رسید}}, \emph{resid}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
